Message:
crypto: testmgr - add SM4 cts-cbc/xts/xcbc test vectors

This patch newly adds the test vectors of CTS-CBC/XTS/XCBC modes of
the SM4 algorithm, and also added some test vectors for SM4 GCM/CCM.
